mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PLAYLIST_LIKES (LIKE_ID, USER_ID, PLAYLIST_ID, STATUS, CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_PLAYLIST_LIKES.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{playlistId}, #{status}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT P.*, 1 AS LIKED FROM PLAYLISTS P JOIN PLAYLIST_LIKES L ON P.PLAYLIST_ID = L.PLAYLIST_ID WHERE L.USER_ID = #{userId} AND L.STATUS = 'Y'
